concepts.title: Multiplication of Fractions
concepts.definition: Multiplying a number by a fraction takes a fraction of it: 3 times 2/5 means 2/5 of 3, computed by multiplying with the numerator and dividing by the denominator.
concepts.key_idea: Of means multiply: the numerator tells how many parts to keep, the denominator how fine the cut is.
question_patterns: find 3 x 2/5
what does 1/2 of 10 mean and what is its value
multiply 2 by 3/4 and give the answer
why is 3 x 1/2 smaller than 3
solve a distance problem using fraction multiplication
shade 2/3 of 12 counters and write the product

solution_steps.explain: First multiply the whole number by the numerator.
Divide the product by the denominator to finish.

concepts.title: Fraction of a Fraction
concepts.definition: Multiplying two fractions multiplies numerators together and denominators together: 1/2 of 1/3 is 1/6, and folding paper strips shows the overlap region that the product names.
concepts.key_idea: Double cutting: one cut across, one cut down, and the product is the piece cut both ways.
question_patterns: find 1/2 of 1/3
multiply 2/3 by 1/5
shade the overlap that shows 1/2 of 2/3
why is a fraction of a fraction smaller than both
solve 3/4 of 4/9
write a story for 1/3 of 3/4 of a cake

concepts.title: Division with Fractions
concepts.definition: Dividing by a fraction asks how many of those fractional pieces fit: dividing by 1/2 doubles the answer, and the rule of multiplying by the reciprocal turns every division into a multiplication.
concepts.key_idea: Dividing by a fraction flips the effect: the reciprocal turns the question into a multiplication you know.
question_patterns: how many halves are there in 3
find 3 divided by 1/2
what is the reciprocal of 3/4
solve 5/6 divided by 1/3 using reciprocals
why does dividing by a fraction give a bigger answer
share 2 rotis in halves and write the division statement

concepts.title: Word Problems with Fractions
concepts.definition: Fraction problems come dressed in stories, water in a tank, part of a journey, a share of a cake; drawing the whole, marking the parts, and writing the operation turns the story into a calculation.
concepts.key_idea: Draw the whole first: a picture of the whole makes the fraction operation obvious.
question_patterns: a tank is 2/3 full and holds 90 litres when full find the water now
Ravi walked 3/4 of a 8 km path how far did he walk
